The Supabase project is in ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) — see the pooler host
in scratch/apply-mig-env.mjs. Functions were running in Vercel's default
iad1 (Washington DC), so every query crossed the Pacific twice: about
210ms each, against about 2ms same-region. Pages here make six or seven
round trips one after another before they can render, so that alone was
one and a half seconds of nothing but network on every navigation.
syd1 is Sydney. Karachi to Sydney is also slightly shorter than Karachi to
Virginia, so users pay nothing for this and the database becomes local.
The better end state for a Karachi office is both in ap-south-1 (Mumbai),
about 40ms from the users. Supabase cannot change a project's region in
place, so that means migrating to a new project — a separate, planned job.
